run_tool_use: run a tool-use function that selects a calculator or search engine to answer a question
run_tip_suggestion: run a tip suggestion function that forks execution to expand multiple tips in parallel
run_regex_generation: run text generation constrained by a regular expression to produce valid IP addresses
run_batch_qa: run batch question answering across multiple questions with a progress bar
run_streaming_qa: run streaming question answering that yields text chunks incrementally
